initial_simplification: Mice are very important for studying the brain. Scientists use mice because they can easily control them and learn how the brain works. In the past, researchers usually chose male mice for experiments instead of female mice. This is because they worried that female mice’s hormone cycles could change their behavior and affect the results.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Scientists often use mice to study the brain. They usually choose male mice because female mice have hormone changes that can affect the results.
